parsed.note_claim: William Barr was the United States Attorney General in 2019, but not in 1997.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: served as United States Attorney General in the administration of President George H. W. Bush from 1991 to 1993 and again in the first administration of President Donald Trump from 2019 to 2020.
parsed.reason: The page confirms Barr's terms as Attorney General were 1991-1993 and 2019-2020, substantiating the note's claim that he held the position in 2019 but not 1997.
